tagline: Istanbul's commercial and shopping heartland — Nişantaşı's neighbour, home to major malls, business districts, and some excellent neighbourhood dining.

items.name: Kahve Dünyası (Şişli)
items.description: A reliable Turkish coffee chain with multiple branches around Şişli. Good for a quick stop between errands.

items.name: Costa Coffee (Cevahir Mall)
items.description: Conveniently placed inside Cevahir for a break between shopping. Better-than-average mall coffee.

items.name: Şişli Döner Tarihi
items.description: One of Şişli's most beloved döner spots. Thin-sliced lamb döner on fresh bread — a proper Istanbul lunch.
items.tip: Go at 12:30 when the döner is at its peak. Cash preferred.

items.name: Akın's Çorba
items.description: Outstanding soup kitchen with a rotating daily menu of traditional Turkish soups. Popular with office workers for lunch.

items.name: Cevahir Mall Food Court
items.description: One of Europe's largest malls with a wide variety of dining options across all price points.

items.name: Cevahir AVM
items.description: One of Europe's largest shopping malls with over 300 stores, cinemas, and restaurants. Everything under one roof.

items.name: Şişli-Nişantaşı Border Streets
items.description: The streets between Şişli and Nişantaşı have a mix of mid-range fashion, homeware, and local shops at better prices than the luxury Abdi İpekçi strip.

items.name: Şişli Meydanı
items.description: The central square and transport hub of Şişli. Busy, functional, and a good orientation point for the area.

items.name: Walk to Nişantaşı
items.description: A 10-minute walk south from Şişli brings you to the upscale Nişantaşı shopping and dining district — a good combination.

tips: Şişli metro stop (M2) is the main access point — very well connected to the rest of the city.
For dining and cafés, nearby Nişantaşı or Cihangir are better destinations. Şişli excels for shopping and transport.
Mecidiyeköy (just east) is the main business hub — good for business meetings and services.
The area between Şişli and Osmanbey has some excellent local eateries that office workers know but tourists rarely find.
